findings: Pinned immutable selector artifact is byte-authenticated before endpoint traversal; future/unstarted references are deferred rather than invented.

Each selected archive/COMMIT is byte-hashed with stable inode/size/mtime/mode; repeated paths verify digest/stat identity.
Each terminal source/result/receipt/full custody proof is authenticated; natural0/CLOSED, exact result/source/receipt hashes and original owner association are mandatory.

limited_behavior: Deferral covers future endpoints and dataless archive payloads. Missing/dataless COMMIT/source/receipt/proof or failed seal/schema/owner assertion is a refusal, not a deferred equality or recall.
scope: Focused full-source static peer for root-owned read-only measurement of resident closed endpoints. No numerical arrays, live archives or producer definitions evaluated by reviewer.
